completedTasks.title: Scaffold freshness guard must be blind-spot-proof (F2 + --skills '' trap)
completedTasks.summary: Root cause found and verified: NOT nondeterminism — the scaffolder's --skills argv accepted a literal two-char '' (non-shell transport) as a garbage skill name, silently skipped it, and delivered only include-derived + stack-local skills (11/32, 128 entries, exit 0); the guard's --skills '' recovery inherited any narrowing, so lost mirrors were never regenerated and tree-vs-tree diffs saw nothing (F2). A narrowed manifest had shipped in-repo at ea17ae60 (0.140.0). Fixes: D3 argv validation (quoting artifacts always refused exit 2; unknown names refused unless catalog-or-manifest-known; ''/',' recovery untouched); D1 shared expected_skill_names oracle in badger_lib (delivery BLOCK order — flat-sorted empirically fails healthy trees via manifest row order; Scaffolder consumes only the include-derived block so narrow argv never gains defaults); D2 guard fail-fast on manifest⊊expected (Narrowing→exit 1, names mirror PATHS, prints remediation block, hedges index-staleness); R3 guard argv carries the explicit config-derived set (never --skills '', never bare omission — the front-door trap when DEFAULT_SKILLS walks empty); R4 AC0 double-scaffold confirmed 42-path loss already repaired at 0.149.1; R5 gotcha in welcome-ai-badger SKILL.md + guard rationale clause. Release 0.150.0, tag on remote, CI green (tests/lint/gates/consumer-journey). MoE: 3 plan lanes (architect lane died on upstream timeouts twice — findings transcribed from its probe log; test-engineer + reviewer re-dispatched with incremental-write protocol), api-engineer APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES + qa REQUEST-CHANGES (probes falsified 3 RED expectations; recipes rebuilt) all folded. Red-first: AC1–AC4 witnessed RED pre-fix, GREEN post-fix. Suite 4763/0 twice consecutively (d-16 ruling satisfied); F1 in-suite flake not reproduced post-rewrite (3 negative runs, root cause still unknown — time-box closed).
